name: ProjectProfitabilityAnalyzer
tagline: EAC, budget burn and margin by project and phase – with a forecast approval workflow.
description: A complete project-profitability app for consulting, accounting and advisory firms: estimate at completion with three methods, contract-type aware revenue, budget vs forecast margin and erosion, burn vs progress, a margin bridge per phase and a Not reviewed → Under review → Recovery plan → Approved forecast workflow with validation, bulk actions and undo.
features: Bottom-up ETC, CPI and remaining-budget EAC methods
Fixed fee, T&M, capped T&M and retainer revenue logic
Healthy / Watch / At risk with reasons
Forecast review workflow with recovery plans and stale-forecast rules
Bulk approve, request ETC update, export
Search, sort, group, filters drawer, paging for 500+ rows
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: ProjectProfitabilityAnalyzer data-set + ProjectProfitabilityAnalyzerPortal field)
